name: Normal flow example
description: Normal Flow starts without a Root User Task

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="NO000000000108_di" bpmnElement="NO000000000108">
        <dc:Bounds x="300" y="200" width="60" height="60" />

      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="FLNORMAL000001_di" bpmnElement="FLNORMAL000001">
